description: Abandoned and recovered carts for a single reporting period.
label: Abandoned cart report

period_label.label: Period
period_label.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

period_start.label: Period start
period_start.description: Inclusive start of the reporting window.

period_end.label: Period end
period_end.description: Exclusive end of the reporting window.

abandoned_count.label: Abandoned carts
abandoned_count.description: Carts abandoned in the period, including those later recovered.

abandoned_value.label: Abandoned value
abandoned_value.description: Total of those carts when they were abandoned.

recovered_count.label: Recovered carts
recovered_count.description: Abandoned carts that later became an order.

open_count.label: Still open
open_count.description: Abandoned carts that have not become an order.

abandoned_carts.label: Largest abandoned carts
abandoned_carts.description: The highest-value carts abandoned in the period.

products_left.label: Products left in carts
products_left.description: The products with the most value left in abandoned carts.

truncated.label: Partial
truncated.description: Set when a read hit its page ceiling, so counts are a lower bound.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: Display only: the dashboard draws the headline figures here from the report's other fields. Never stored.
